stories.title: Border Patrol has a history of excessive force. Critics say they're unprepared in Minneapolis
stories.summary: People who study the Border Patrol say it continues to be less well prepared than big city police for handling crowds and situations involving protesters, some of whom are legally armed.

stories.title: Myanmar finishes the final phase of its election, which critics call a sham
stories.summary: Myanmar completed its third and final round of voting on Sunday in a monthlong general election called by the ruling military junta — an election that critics call a sham.

stories.title: Fight over DHS funding has the government on track for a partial shutdown
stories.summary: Efforts in Congress to avoid a partial government shutdown have been scrambled by two fatal shootings in Minneapolis this month involving ICE officers.

stories.title: Alex Pretti remembered as friend, nurse and dog dad
stories.summary: Two days after VA nurse Alex Pretti was fatally shot by federal agents, we learn more about who he was from his friend.

stories.title: Neighbors and church members transformed the home of a man with terminal cancer
stories.summary: In 2007, Larry Maxfield helped his brother Marty move to Utah. Marty had terminal cancer. Neighbors and church members helped transform Marty's new house into a warm home during his final days.

stories.title: Are snow days bad for students?
stories.summary: If you have ever experienced the giddy freedom of a snow day, you are not alone. But while most kids love the days off, is there an impact on academic performance?
